note: Film B sound effects (ElevenLabs). 'npm run el -- sfx --film=b' makes all that are missing into public/sfx/b/. The mix falls back to synthesised sounds for any file not there yet.

sounds.prompt: A huge stadium floodlight switching on at night: a heavy electrical contactor slamming shut with a deep metallic clunk, then a rising electrical hum as the lamp powers up. Close, dry, cinematic, no music
A huge stadium floodlight switching off at night: a heavy relay clunk, then the electrical hum dies away into silence. Close, dry, cinematic, no music
A single small industrial relay clicking on with a tiny electrical crackle, crisp and short, close
A rapid cascade of industrial relays and breakers clicking on one after another, ending with a power surge hum, cinematic
Massive power breakers slamming on in an empty stadium at night, deep booming metallic clunks with a long echo
Stadium floodlights shutting down one by one: heavy clunks in sequence, electrical hum winding down, then echoing silence
A metal-halide lamp warming up: a soft rising electrical whine and gentle buzz getting brighter, subtle, close
A single soft tap on a smartphone glass screen with a subtle haptic click, close-up, quiet room
A smartphone screen gently waking up in a silent dark room, a very soft airy electronic swell
A short modern smartphone push notification chime, clean, soft, two notes
A quick finger swipe dismissing a phone notification, short airy swoosh
A stadium LED scoreboard powering on: a crackling sweep of tiny relays clicking left to right, ending in a bright electrical tone
A soft chat message bubble pop from a modern messenger app, gentle
A fast digital counter rolling up with soft rapid mechanical ticking, ending with a single click
A distant football crowd roaring inside a stadium at night, heard from far away, warm and muffled
A deep cinematic sub-bass impact with a long dark tail, trailer hit, clean, no music
A slow soft cinematic air whoosh passing by, subtle and smooth
